1. Hi Jo, I cleaned the floor already. You don’t have to do it again; please tidy the sofa instead. Mum

2. GUEST ROOM — Towels and mugs are available. You needn’t bring your own.

3. Hi Dad, I have to finish my homework before I go out. I’ll stay home until six. Sam

4. CLOSED CABINET — You must not open this cabinet. Ask an adult for anything inside.

5. Hi Eva, you don’t need to bring a key. I’ll be home to open the door. Jo

6. WASHING-UP PLAN — Leo washes plates today; Ruby does it tomorrow. Everyone clears their own mug.
